APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

64 oz pitcher

Backyard BBQ ↗

A 64 oz acrylic pitcher with lid and pour spout: The lid keeps insects out and the spout pours without soaking the cloth.

Outdoor Bars ↗

Clear body shows how much is left without lifting the lid.

Tailgate & Car Parties ↗

Set it on the tailgate and let the row pour their own.

Confirm for your project

Check table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions；service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
